# Drywall.info

> > Comprehensive drywall resource covering repair techniques, installation guides, material selection, and professional tool recommendations for DIYers and contractors.

Drywall.info provides expert tutorials on drywall finishing, joint compound application, and repair methods, along with practical calculators for estimating materials like screws, mud, and sheets. The site features detailed product reviews of tools from DEWALT, Ridgid, Makita, and Milwaukee, plus guides on specialized techniques like popcorn ceiling removal and corner bead selection.

## Key Topics

- Joint compound and drywall mud types
- Drywall finishing techniques
- Drywall installation and repair
- Corner bead selection (vinyl vs metal)
- Drywall screw guns (DEWALT, Ridgid, Makita, Milwaukee)
- Material calculators (screws, mud, sheets)
- Popcorn ceiling removal and asbestos testing
- Drywall knife sizes and usage
- Wet vs dry sanding methods
- Type X, green board, and specialty drywall
- Setting compound vs all-purpose mud
- Drywall stilts and sanders
- Blowout patch repair method
- Home renovation and DIY tutorials

## Essential Guides & Tutorials

- [Expert Drywall Repair and Installation Tips](https://www.drywall.info): Homepage for drywall repair, installation tips, and DIY tutorials
- [5 Types of Drywall Mud: A Beginner's Guide to Choosing the Right One](https://www.drywall.info/5-types-of-drywall-mud): Beginner's guide to all-purpose, setting, and lightweight drywall mud
- [Types of Drywall: A Complete Guide to Choosing the Right One for Your Project](https://www.drywall.info/types-of-drywall): Guide to Type X, green board, blue board, and paperless drywall types
- [Drywall Mud 101: How to Choose the Right Compound for a Flawless Finish](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-mud-101-how-to-choose-the-right-compound-for-a-flawless-finish): Guide on choosing fast-setting vs all-purpose compound for finishing
- [How to Patch a Hole in Drywall with a Blowout Patch: A Simple Repair Method](https://www.drywall.info/how-to-patch-a-hole-in-drywall): Tutorial on California blowout patch method for drywall holes

## Material Calculators & Reference Tools

- [Drywall Calculator – Quickly Estimate How Many Sheets You Need](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-calculator): Calculator tool for estimating drywall sheets needed by dimensions
- [Drywall Screw Calculator – Estimate Screws Needed per Board](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-screw-calculator): Calculator tool to estimate drywall screws needed per board
- [How Many Screws Per Sheet of Drywall? (Plus a Handy Drywall Screw Calculator)](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-screw-calculator-guide): Guide on screw spacing with calculator for fastener estimation
- [Drywall Mud Calculator – Estimate How Much Joint Compound You Need](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-mud-calculator): Calculator for joint compound estimation by square footage

## Finishing Techniques & Methods

- [How Long Does Drywall Mud Take to Dry? (What Pros Know)](https://www.drywall.info/how-long-does-drywall-mud-take-to-dry): Guide on drywall mud drying times and acceleration techniques
- [Sanding vs. Wet Drywall Sanding: The Method for Dust-Free Drywall Repairs](https://www.drywall.info/dry-vs-wet-drywall-sanding): Comparison of wet vs dry sanding techniques for dust-free finishing
- [Best Size Drywall Knife for Finishing](https://www.drywall.info/best-size-drywall-knife-for-finishing): Guide on using 6", 8", 10", and 12" drywall knives for finishing
- [Drywall Sander Guide: How to Choose the Right One for a Flawless Finish](https://www.drywall.info/drywall-sander-guide): Guide to manual, electric, and vacuum drywall sanders selection
- [Popcorn Ceiling Removal: A Step-by-Step Guide to a Smooth, Modern Ceiling](https://www.drywall.info/popcorn-ceiling-removal): Step-by-step guide for popcorn ceiling removal with asbestos testing tips

## Tool Reviews & Recommendations

- [Best Drywall Screw Guns 2025: What Pros & DIYers Recommend](https://www.drywall.info/best-drywall-screw-guns-2025): 2025 reviews of DEWALT, Ridgid, and Makita drywall screw guns
- [6 Reasons to Choose Vinyl Corner Bead Over Metal for Your Drywall Projects](https://www.drywall.info/6-reasons-to-choose-vinyl-corner-bead): Comparison of vinyl vs metal corner bead for drywall projects
